summary: Corner Growth Acquisition Corp. 2 filed an 8-K announcing that its board of directors determined it could not complete an initial business combination and will liquidate and dissolve under Cayman Islands law. The registrant will redeem public shares at a per-share price equal to the aggregate cash in the trust account, including earned interest not previously released (less up to $100,000 for expenses and net of taxes), dividing that amount by the number of outstanding public shares. The redemption extinguishes shareholders' rights. No advisor or premium is mentioned. The process is subject to creditor claims and Cayman law. The liquidation is a final dissolution; watch for the redemption price calculation and any delays from regulatory requirements.
